#### Schemas

- [Overview](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/schemas.md): What schemas are in WarpDrive, how a ResourceSchema turns raw API data into records, and which schema mode, LegacyMode or PolarisMode, to choose.
- [ResourceSchemas](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/schemas/resources.md): What a ResourceSchema is, how to create and register one, and the common field kinds it declares, including the resource and collection relationship fields.
- [ObjectSchemas](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/schemas/object-schemas.md)
- [SimpleFields](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/schemas/simple-fields.md)
- [Relational Fields](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/schemas/relational-fields.md): How to declare the resource and collection relationship fields in a schema, what value they produce on a record in LegacyMode and PolarisMode, and how they differ from the legacy belongsTo and hasMany kinds.
- [Complex Fields](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/schemas/complex-fields.md)
- [Traits](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/schemas/traits.md)
- [Derivations](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/schemas/derivations.md)
- [Transformations](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/schemas/transformations.md)
- [Extensions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/schemas/extensions.md)

##### Resources

- [ResourceSchemas](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/schemas/resources.md): What a ResourceSchema is, how to create and register one, and the common field kinds it declares, including the resource and collection relationship fields.
- [LegacyMode (recommended)](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/schemas/resources/legacy-mode.md): What LegacyMode is, why it is the current recommendation for most apps, its drawbacks for non-Ember apps, and how to migrate from Model to it.
- [PolarisMode (preview)](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/schemas/resources/polaris-mode.md): What PolarisMode is, how it differs from LegacyMode, why it is still in preview, and which relationship field kinds it supports.

#### Relational Data

- [Overview](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/relational-data.md): Overview of relationships in WarpDrive, the resource and collection field kinds that work the same in LegacyMode and PolarisMode, and how they compare to the legacy belongsTo and hasMany kinds.
- [Directionality](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/relational-data/advanced/directionality.md): How the inverse option makes a relationship unidirectional or bidirectional, and how direction affects which records see an edit and what gets loaded.
- [Many To Many Relationships](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/relational-data/configuration/many-to-many.md)
- [Collection Relationships](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/relational-data/features/collection-relationships.md): How to declare a collection relationship field, what its relationship document value contains, and how to fetch, mutate, and create records through it.
- [Adding & Removing](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/relational-data/mutating/adding-removing.md): How to add, remove, and replace related records on an editable record, including checkout for PolarisMode records and the legacy belongsTo and hasMany APIs.
- [Relationship Specification](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/relational-data/spec.md): The normative rules for relationship payloads, what each relationship field kind requires of the API, how values and mutation behave, and how the rules are enforced.

##### Advanced

- [Directionality](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/relational-data/advanced/directionality.md): How the inverse option makes a relationship unidirectional or bidirectional, and how direction affects which records see an edit and what gets loaded.
- [Large Collections](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/relational-data/advanced/large-collections.md): When a list is too large for a collection relationship, how to load it as its own request instead, and how maxCollectionRelationshipSize enforces the limit.
- [Pagination](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/relational-data/advanced/pagination.md): Why relationships are never paginated in WarpDrive, and how to page through related records with top-level requests, including through the relationship's own link.
- [Understanding "the Graph"](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/relational-data/advanced/the-graph.md): How the cache stores relationship state in the Graph, why edits are operations rather than assignments, and how remote and local state are kept apart.

##### Configuration

- [Many To Many Relationships](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/relational-data/configuration/many-to-many.md)
- [Many To None Relationships](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/relational-data/configuration/many-to-none.md)

##### Features

- [Collection Relationships](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/relational-data/features/collection-relationships.md): How to declare a collection relationship field, what its relationship document value contains, and how to fetch, mutate, and create records through it.
- [Relationship Inverses](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/relational-data/features/inverses.md)
- [Links vs Identifiers](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/relational-data/features/links-vs-identifiers.md): The difference between links and resource identifiers in a relationship payload, which one your API should send, and why links are never followed automatically.
- [Relationship Polymorphism](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/relational-data/features/polymorphism.md)
- [Resource Relationships](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/relational-data/features/resource-relationships.md): How to declare a resource relationship field, what its relationship document value contains, and how to fetch, mutate, and create records through it.
- [Sync vs Async](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/relational-data/features/sync-vs-async.md): What the async option means for resource and collection relationships, the payload contract each setting enforces, and how to choose between them.

##### Mutating

- [Adding & Removing](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/relational-data/mutating/adding-removing.md): How to add, remove, and replace related records on an editable record, including checkout for PolarisMode records and the legacy belongsTo and hasMany APIs.
- [Saving](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/relational-data/mutating/saving.md): How to persist relationship edits with a request or by committing without one, and how saving related records works for resource, collection, and legacy fields.
- [Sorting & Filtering](https://canary.warp-drive.io/guides/the-manual/relational-data/mutating/sorting-filtering.md): Why relationships are not sorted or filtered in place, and how to sort or filter related records for display or on the server instead.

### Upgrading

- [Migrating 4.x to 5.x](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11248/upgrading/v5.md): How to upgrade an EmberData 4.x app to WarpDrive 5.x by moving to native types, migrating with a second store, and converting Models to schemas.

#### 4.x → 5.x

- [Migrating 4.x to 5.x](https://canary.warp-drive.io/upgrading/v5.md): How to upgrade an EmberData 4.x app to WarpDrive 5.x by moving to native types, migrating with a second store, and converting Models to schemas.
- [Migrating Between Versions Using The Two Store Approach](https://canary.warp-drive.io/upgrading/v5/two-store-migration.md)
- [Using Codemods](https://canary.warp-drive.io/upgrading/v5/codemods.md)
- [Migrating Relationships to resource and collection](https://canary.warp-drive.io/upgrading/v5/relationships.md): How to migrate belongsTo and hasMany fields to the resource and collection relationship kinds, which work the same in LegacyMode and PolarisMode, one field at a time.
- [Migrating Async Relationship Usage](https://canary.warp-drive.io/upgrading/v5/relationship-usage.md): How to migrate templates, getters, and computed properties that read async belongsTo and hasMany relationships implicitly, in three phases ending on the resource and collection kinds.
